tagline: North Shore's trusted STIHL outdoor power equipment shop
heroSubheading: Fully assembled STIHL equipment, expert advice, and reliable service for your property.
aboutHtml:
We're Raman and his team at STIHL SHOP Glenfield. We stock the full range of STIHL outdoor power equipment, from lawnmowers and chainsaws to hedge trimmers, brush cutters, blower vacs, and more. Everything in our bright, modern store is fully assembled, fuelled, tested and ready to go, so you can see the quality for yourself before you buy.

We have genuine practical knowledge with STIHL and other major outdoor power brands. Our team has real experience using this gear, not just selling it. Whether you need the right tool for a one-off job or you're stocking a fleet, we'll help you find what works best for your needs.

Our fully equipped workshop means we can service and repair all major makes and models, not just STIHL. From pre-delivery setup to ongoing maintenance and repair, we stand behind every product we sell. Come in and experience the difference quality makes.
